message.content: The vulnerability is in `libdeflate_zlib_decompress_ex` which is part of the libdeflate library. The out-of-bounds read happens in `get_unaligned_be16`/`load_u16_unaligned` reading 2 bytes past the end of the input buffer. This is a known libdeflate bug. Let me look at the libdeflate source in the repo.
